what_it_is.prose: Boeing is a top-tier Indian defence partner with the broadest US-OEM Indian footprint. India operates: 22 AH-64E Apache attack helicopters (contract Sep 2015, with 6 more for the Indian Army; final batch delivered December 2025); 12 P-8I Neptune maritime patrol aircraft for the Indian Navy (last delivered Feb 2022) with discussions for 6 more in a $3.5B deal (Apr 2026); 10 C-17 Globemaster III strategic airlifters (contract Jun 2011, IAF No. 81 Squadron 'Skylords'); and 15 CH-47F Chinook heavy-lift helicopters (Sep 2015 contract, deliveries complete). Boeing also operates Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) in Bengaluru — Boeing's largest campus outside the US — inaugurated by PM Modi on 20 January 2024. The Tata-Boeing Aerospace Systems (TBAS) JV in Hyderabad produces 737 MAX vertical fin structures and Apache fuselages.

faq.question: How many Apache helicopters has India bought from Boeing?
faq.answer: India has contracted 28 AH-64E Apache attack helicopters from Boeing: 22 for the Indian Air Force (contract signed 29 September 2015) and 6 for the Indian Army Aviation Corps (additional contract February 2020). The final batch was delivered to the Indian Army in December 2025.

faq.question: How many P-8I Neptune aircraft does the Indian Navy operate?
faq.answer: The Indian Navy operates 12 P-8I Neptune maritime patrol aircraft delivered by Boeing (initial 8 + follow-on 4; last delivery February 2022). The Navy is in discussions for 6 additional aircraft in a ~$3.5 billion deal reported in April 2026.

faq.question: Where is Boeing's largest engineering campus outside the US?
faq.answer: The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) in Bengaluru, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 20 January 2024, is Boeing's largest engineering & technology campus outside the United States.
